name: spesenportal
description: Digitales Spesenportal (WEB I / DTR II): Backend (NestJS, MariaDB) und Frontend (HTML, CSS, JavaScript ohne Framework)

scripts.start: concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
